cards.subject: Silverlaine Keep
lines: It was a nobleman's house, and the man is still in it.
Shadowfang is the name it got afterwards.

cards.subject: The Book of Ur
cards.tag: A warning, read as a recipe
lines: Ur was a Dalaran mage who catalogued things from outside the world. He studied the worgen and wrote them up.
His conclusion: no pact may be struck, no secrets learned, no good can come from these beasts.
Arugal read it and summoned them anyway.

seed.body: The book is in here. Somebody wrote down exactly why not to do this and it did not help at all.

cards.subject: The household
cards.tag: Haunted Servitor · Wailing Guardsman · Tormented Officer
lines: Read the names of the things you are killing. The servants, the guards and the officers are all still here, still at their posts.
The guardsmen still guard. Their scream cuts a spellcast in half.
That noise in the halls is the staff.

cards.subject: Forsaken Skills
lines: It does not touch your stats. It takes one hundred points off a single skill for five minutes.
You start missing with your own sword and nothing on your screen says why.
Retail replaced it with a tidy percentage. This is the original.

cards.subject: Ten, not five
lines: Every dungeon up to Maraudon holds ten people.
Nothing inside scales. Ten is simply ten.
Almost nobody ever brings them.

cards.subject: Sorcerer Ashcrombe
lines: The Kirin Tor sent him to check on Arugal. He was caught and locked up.
He opens the sealed courtyard door in about two seconds.
On his own cell door: "Too bad the cell doors weren't locked so haphazardly."

cards.subject: What Lies Beyond
lines: Ashcrombe had a real quest in beta. It was cut.
The text was not thrown away — it is the small talk he gives you when you free him.
Its last line: "You defeated Rethilgore, perhaps you will survive what lies beyond..."

cards.subject: Deathstalker Vincent
lines: Two Forsaken were sent in to scout. Adamant was captured. Vincent was not.
Arugal stood over him and said his remains would serve as a testament to trespassing.
He is still lying where he was left.

cards.subject: The horses
lines: The courtyard is the only open air in the building, and what is standing in it is a felsteed.
Both of them are demonic and neither has a rider.
The Shadow Charger was a felhorse here too. It was not made a skeleton until long after.

cards.subject: Baron Silverlaine
cards.tag: The man who owned the house
lines: The worgen Arugal called besieged the keep and killed him and everyone in it.
His ghost is the one that tells you to leave.
He is still defending his own front rooms.

cards.subject: Odo the Blindwatcher
lines: The keep's lookout cannot see.
He lives in a wooden lean-to hanging off the outside of the building.
Go outside and look back at it.

cards.subject: Deathsworn Captain
cards.tag: The only rare in the keep
lines: He was killed defending the place when Arugal came.
He is still walking the walls he died on.
Nothing else in here is rare. He is the whole roll-call.

cards.subject: Fenrus the Devourer
cards.yell: The roar carries into every room in the keep.
lines: When you open his door he roars, and it is not a local sound.
Whatever anyone else in the building is doing, they hear it at the same moment you do.

cards.subject: Arugal's Voidwalkers
cards.tag: Four of them, after the wolf
lines: Fenrus is not the end of that room. Arugal appears and puts four void demons on the floor.
They heal each other.
The man whose entire crime was summoning one thing from somewhere else also keeps demons in the house.

cards.subject: Arugal's Curse
lines: He does not summon a worgen at you. He turns one of you into one.
For ten seconds that player belongs to him and fights the rest of you.
He says "Release your rage!" when it happens.

cards.subject: Pyrewood Village
cards.tag: Below the keep · nine at night
lines: The village at the foot of the hill is cursed, and the curse runs on a clock.
At nine in the evening, server time, every villager turns.
The armorer will sell to you at noon. At night he is the Moonrage Armorer and he wants you dead.

seed.body: Go down to Pyrewood at 8:55pm server and just stand in the road. Worth doing once.

cards.subject: Son of Arugal
lines: It did not stay in the building. He seeded them across the whole forest.
They are elite, they are level 24 to 25, and the zone around them is built for level 10.
That is the actual consequence of the book he read.
